fusions.name: Run to Ground
fusions.desc: Usable only on a target at or below 25% health: a gust runs it down up to 8 tiles away and deals 22 damage, rising to 1.4 times that at full reach.

fusions.name: Quarry Marked
fusions.desc: Sends a scenting gust into the first enemy it meets, dealing 11 damage, stunning it for 1 second and leaving it [Marked] for 10 seconds.

fusions.name: Closing In
fusions.desc: Increases your movement speed by 30% for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Scent of Weakness
fusions.desc: Against targets below half health, you deal 12% more damage.
